283692.title: Strontium carbonate
283692.boundary: The main traded strontium chemical, made from celestite. The exporter is the processor, not necessarily the miner.

281640.title: Oxides/hydroxides/peroxides of strontium or barium
281640.boundary: Strontium is lumped with barium here and cannot be isolated; a small market.
